build_trainer_for_multilingual_code_mode: build a Trainer instance to train a multilingual code model with CLM and MLM objectives
create_encdec_trainer_for_code_translati: create an EncDecTrainer to train an encoder-decoder model for code translation between programming languages
run_clm_step_for_causal_prediction: run a causal language modeling step to predict the next token in a code sequence
run_mlm_step_for_masked_prediction: run a masked language modeling step to predict masked tokens in code with noise injection
run_mt_step_for_code_translation: run a machine translation step to train code translation between two programming languages
run_bt_step_for_back_translation: run a back-translation step to generate synthetic parallel data for code translation training
run_st_step_with_unit_tests: run a self-training step that generates code translations and validates them with unit tests
run_denoising_autoencoding_step: run a denoising auto-encoding step to reconstruct code from a noisy version of itself
run_deobfuscation_step: run a deobfuscation step to train the model to recover original variable and function names from obfuscated code
mask_tokens_for_mlm_training: mask out random tokens in a batch of code sequences for masked language modeling training
deobfuscate_code_identifiers: deobfuscate class, function, and variable names in code with a given probability for training
save_model_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint including optimizer state and training metrics to disk
reload_model_checkpoint: reload a model checkpoint to resume training from a previous state
optimize_model_with_gradient_clipping: optimize the model parameters with gradient clipping and support for FP16 and AMP training
generate_parallel_code_examples: generate parallel code examples using beam search and validate them with test runners
get_training_batch_from_iterator: get a batch of code sentences from a data iterator for training
create_single_trainer_with_classifier: create a SingleTrainer with an optional classifier for code classification tasks
run_classification_step: run a classification step to train a classifier on encoded code representations
save_best_model_by_metric: save the best model checkpoint based on validation metrics like BLEU or accuracy
round_batch_for_fp16_training: round batch dimensions to multiples of 8 for efficient FP16 training on GPU
